{"user":"I'm an indie founder building a B2B SaaS. Can you help me draft a 1-page go-to-market plan for launching in the next 30 days? I already know my target customer and main pain point; I just need a practical plan with channels, outreach sequence, and what metrics to track.","plus_response":"Absolutely—here’s a practical 1-page go-to-market plan for a 30-day B2B SaaS launch, with channels, an outreach sequence, and tracking metrics. I’ll also include a lightweight weekly scoreboard and a simple iteration loop so you can adjust fast during the launch window.

GO-TO-MARKET PLAN (30 DAYS)

1) Objectives (Days 1–2)
- Primary goal: Book qualified discovery calls.
- Secondary goals: Reach ICP prospects, get early feedback on messaging, and convert to pilots.
- Success targets (edit to your baseline):
  - 150–250 targeted prospects contacted
  - 25–40 replies
  - 10–20 discovery calls
  - 2–5 pilot commitments (or clear “next step”)

2) Positioning & Offer (Days 1–2)
- ICP: (use what you already know)
- Pain point: (use your stated pain)
- Value proposition: 1 sentence outcome + who it’s for.
- Offer for the next 30 days:
  - “Pilot with onboarding + success checklist” (time-boxed)
  - Include a clear definition of success (e.g., first workflow live, first report generated)

3) Channels (Days 3–30)
A) Outbound (Primary)
- LinkedIn + email sequencing
- 70% of effort: outbound to ICP
- 30% of effort: refine messaging based on reply reasons

B) Partnerships / Communities (Secondary)
- 5–10 warm-ish connections: consultants, agencies, niche associations
- 2 community posts: one “teaser insight,” one “pilot invitation”

C) Content Lite (Supporting)
- Publish 2 short assets (no long blog required):
  - A problem-to-solution post (pain + what you built + who it’s for)
  - A one-page case study template using your beta learnings (even if informal)

4) Outreach Sequence (Example: 10 Business Days per prospect) 
Day 1: Initial email / LinkedIn message
- Personal hook tied to their context
- One-line value + specific relevance
- Ask: “Worth a 15-min call to see if this fits?”

Day 3: Follow-up with “micro-proof”
- Mention a concrete result, metric, or demo artifact
- Ask a narrower question (e.g., “Are you currently handling X manually or via Y?”)

Day 6: Follow-up with use-case
- 3 bullets: who it helps, where it fits, what changes
- Offer: pilot invitation (time-boxed)

Day 9: Break-up / objection-handling
- “If this isn’t a priority, what would be a better next step?”
- Provide a low-effort alternative (e.g., “If you share your current workflow, I can suggest where we’d integrate.”)

Day 11+: Optional bump based on engagement
- If they engaged on LinkedIn or clicked: send a tailored message with the best-matching asset

5) Lead Qualification (Simple)
Score prospects 0–2 on:
- Fit: matches ICP and pain
- Urgency: they have a deadline or active initiative
- Access: decision maker or clear path to one

Goal: prioritize top-fit leads for calls and pilot conversion.

6) Metrics to Track (Weekly scoreboard)
Outbound funnel:
- Prospects targeted
- Emails/messages sent
- Deliveries (or attempts)
- Reply rate
- Positive reply rate (shows pain + interest)
- Discovery call rate (from replies)
- Pilot conversion rate (from calls)
- Time to first reply

Diagnostics:
- Top 3 reply reasons (manually tag)
- Best-performing subject lines / first sentences
- Drop-off stage (where leads go silent)

7) Iteration Loop (Every 3–4 days)
- Pick one variable at a time:
  - messaging angle
  - offer wording
  - call ask (broader vs narrower)
- Update sequence and landing message accordingly.

8) What to prepare before Day 1 (Quick checklist)
- 1 short demo script (under 5 minutes)
- a pilot landing page or doc (one page)
- a discovery call agenda + follow-up email template

If you want, I can also turn this into a ready-to-use Google Doc layout plus a copy-paste outreach template pack (3 email variants + 3 LinkedIn variants) and a pilot onboarding one-pager—taking care of the extra materials that usually slow founders down right before launch.","minus_response":"Here’s a practical 1-page go-to-market plan for your 30-day launch.

1) Objectives
- Primary: book qualified discovery calls.
- Secondary: convert a small number of pilots (or get clear next steps).

2) Channels (pick 1 primary, 1 secondary)
- Primary: outbound (LinkedIn + email) to your ICP list.
- Secondary: light community/partnership outreach (a few DMs + 1–2 posts).
- Optional: 1 short “problem/solution” post to support outbound.

3) Outreach sequence (10 business days)
- Day 1: initial message (personal hook + 1-line value + ask for 15-min call).
- Day 3: follow-up with a micro-proof (demo screenshot, metric, or brief outcome).
- Day 6: follow-up with a use-case (3 bullets: who it helps, where it fits, what changes).
- Day 9: break-up/objection handling (ask for the right next step).

4) Offer
- Time-boxed pilot: onboarding + success checklist.
- Include a clear definition of success (what you’ll get done in the pilot).

5) Metrics to track weekly
- Prospects contacted
- Reply rate
- Discovery call rate
- Pilot conversion rate
- Top reply reasons (just a quick manual tag: fit/urgency/timing/needs more info)

If you share your exact ICP and pain point wording (1–2 sentences), I can help you tailor the first outreach message and the pilot success criteria—but the rest you can adapt as you run the sequence and watch where prospects drop off."}
